highlights_headline: This in-progress 3.119.5 servicing release backports Apple 26.0 support and fixes a WinUI projection DLL issue.

bullets.detail: Unversioned app TFMs now work against the Apple 26.0 native library.
Fixed the WinUI Projection DLL not being found for .NET 9 consumers.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backported Apple 26.0 library support and unversioned app TFMs.
